events.title: Remembering Tupac Shakur
events.blurb: It's 30 years since the iconic rapper Tupac Shakur was shot in Las Vegas.

angles.name: Tupac Tribute
angles.copy: Thirty years on, the music and legacy of Tupac Shakur continue to resonate, a powerful voice from the 90s that changed hip-hop forever.

events.title: Jimi Hendrix: A Legend Remembered
events.blurb: We remember guitar legend Jimi Hendrix, who passed away on this day 56 years ago.

angles.name: Jimi Hendrix Legacy
angles.copy: Still unmatched, still unbelievable. Remembering the unparalleled genius of Jimi Hendrix, whose guitar work continues to inspire generations.

events.title: Abbey Road Turns 57
events.blurb: The Beatles released their iconic album 'Abbey Road' on this day in 1969.

angles.name: Abbey Road Anniversary
angles.copy: That zebra crossing, those tracks. 57 years since The Beatles gave us the masterpiece that is Abbey Road. Which track is your all-time favourite?

events.title: Chrissie Hynde Turns 75
events.blurb: The Pretenders frontwoman Chrissie Hynde celebrates her 75th birthday today.

angles.name: Chrissie Hynde Birthday
angles.copy: Happy birthday to the formidable Chrissie Hynde, whose distinctive voice and rock 'n' roll attitude have made The Pretenders true legends.

events.title: Liam Gallagher Turns 54
events.blurb: Oasis frontman Liam Gallagher celebrates his 54th birthday today.

angles.name: Liam Gallagher Birthday
angles.copy: Still rocking, still 'biblical'. Happy birthday to the one and only Liam Gallagher, a true icon of British music.

events.title: Imagine Turns 55
events.blurb: John Lennon's timeless anthem 'Imagine' was released as a single on October 11, 1971.

angles.name: Imagine Anniversary
angles.copy: Fifty-five years since John Lennon asked us to Imagine. A powerful message that still resonates today.

events.title: The Original iPod Turns 25
events.blurb: Apple introduced the very first iPod, revolutionising how we listen to music, on October 23, 2001.

angles.name: iPod Anniversary
angles.copy: Twenty-five years ago, Apple dropped the original iPod and changed music forever. Remember your first one? The click wheel was iconic.

events.title: Happy James Bond Day
events.blurb: James Bond Day marks the anniversary of the world premiere of the first Bond film, Dr. No, in 1962.

angles.name: Bond Day
angles.copy: Shaken, not stirred. It's James Bond Day! Which 007 film is your ultimate favourite?

events.title: John Lennon Would Have Been 86
events.blurb: We remember John Lennon, who would have celebrated his 86th birthday today.

angles.name: John Lennon Birthday Tribute
angles.copy: A true visionary and a voice for peace. Remembering John Lennon on what would have been his 86th birthday.

events.title: John Cleese Turns 87
events.blurb: The legendary comedian and actor John Cleese celebrates his 87th birthday today.

angles.name: John Cleese Birthday
angles.copy: From Monty Python to Fawlty Towers, a very happy birthday to the incomparable John Cleese. A true British comedy giant.

events.title: The White Album Turns 58
events.blurb: The Beatles released their self-titled double album, famously known as 'The White Album', on November 22, 1968.

angles.name: White Album Anniversary
angles.copy: Fifty-eight years of groundbreaking sound. The Beatles' 'White Album' dropped today in 1968. So much music, so many stories.

events.title: Remembering Freddie Mercury
events.blurb: We remember the legendary Queen frontman Freddie Mercury, who passed away on this day 35 years ago.

angles.name: Freddie Mercury Tribute
angles.copy: The show must go on. Remembering the incomparable Freddie Mercury, whose voice and stage presence remain legendary.

events.title: Rubber Soul Turns 61
events.blurb: The Beatles released their influential album 'Rubber Soul' on this day in 1965.

angles.name: Rubber Soul Anniversary
angles.copy: A pivotal moment in music history. The Beatles' 'Rubber Soul' dropped 61 years ago today, cementing their evolution.

events.title: Remembering John Lennon
events.blurb: We remember John Lennon, who tragically passed away on this day 46 years ago.

angles.name: John Lennon Death Anniversary
angles.copy: Still missed, still inspiring. Remembering John Lennon, a voice for peace and a musical pioneer.
